9UH3.description: PSI with nine FCPI antenna subunits from Chrysotila roscoffensis. Part of the related 1/4/6/8/9-FCPI study series, not a physiological time course.
notes: Related study entries 9UNU, 9UH4, 9UOF, 9UOV and 9UH3 represent different antenna assemblies. Do not treat antenna number as ordered acclimation or independent biological replication.
The deposited file does not establish a starting-model accession. Exact detergent attribution to this reconstruction is not established in this intake.
9UH3.lineage: A starting-model accession is not established in the deposited initial-refinement-model category. Related study assemblies are retained as provenance, not ancestry.

9HYU.description: PSI-FCP supercomplex with the PsaSOD1/PsaSOD2 heterodimer. PsaA is naturally split: pocket-bearing C-terminal fragment author chain A and N-terminal fragment author chain a; chain IDs are case-sensitive.
notes: PsaA is split between author chains A and a. The P_A/A1_A pocket alignment uses the C-terminal chain A; the separate N-terminal fragment a is recorded and included in the core-neighborhood screen. PsaB is author chain B.
Generic deposited annotation photosystem I on chain A is resolved using independent sequence alignment and cofactor-anchor proximity. The short fragment a is not treated as a complete PsaA.
The primary study describes SEC and native-PAGE preparations with two independently acquired datasets. Exact allocation to this deposited model is not inferred here.
9HYU.lineage: Deposited initial model: in silico model, SwissModel. An explicit starting PDB accession is not established. The primary paper establishes split PsaA and a bound SOD heterodimer.

9KZ9.description: PSI with fourteen ACPI antenna subunits from Rhodomonas sp. NIES-2332. The related eleven-ACPI entry 9L0K is a study assembly, not an independent replicate.
notes: P_A O1D has Tyr602 OH and Thr742 OG1 N/O proximity candidates at 3.08575 and 3.30006 Å. Donor hydrogens, protonation and angles were not verified; these are not confirmed hydrogen bonds.

The deposited P_A Mg to homologous His679 NE2 separation is 3.05697 Å, beyond the automatic discovery cutoff of 3.0 Å. An explicit source-hash-bound mapping report establishes the cofactor role by sequence and nearest-anchor identity; the general cutoff is unchanged.

Primary study: Rhodomonas sp. NIES-2332 cells grown in F/2 medium at 20 °C with 3% CO2. PsaA/PsaB sequences were obtained from cDNA; several smaller core subunits were modeled using R. salina sequences.
9KZ9.lineage: Primary model-building Methods use Rhodomonas salina PSI-ACPI 8WM6 as the starting model. The empty deposited initial-model category is distinguished from this paper evidence.

8XLS.description: Diatom PSI monomer associated with five FCPI subunits. Core-pocket comparisons retain the PsaA/PsaB alignment frame rather than aligning the peripheral antenna.
notes: Primary study identifies five FCPI subunits associated with one PSI core from strain CCMP1335. Native assembly and antenna architecture are not inferred from the cropped contact scenes.
The deposited initial-model category records an experimental model with source Other but no accession. An explicit starting PDB accession is not assigned from that category.
8XLS.lineage: Primary Methods describe ModelAngelo-generated subunit models and manual adjustment against postprocessed and Topaz-denoised maps. The deposited initial-model category records experimental model / Other without an accession; an explicit starting PDB is not established.

scope: Primary-paper and deposited metadata reconciled before generation; local maps for these four entries remain unreviewed.
